Trade Sack

You knot the mouth of the sack and test whether the load will hold.

Rules

ID: item-trade-sack

Market price: 1 coins. Bulk: 1.

Reusable sack, Bulk 1 in addition to contents. It provides no extra carrying capacity. Large collections of small valuables must be bundled and counted; no infinite coin pouch.

Buying equipment grants no DP advancement, training or ability. Use normal item-handling actions unless an applicable card says otherwise.
